body: r34-agentauth (2026-10-07): agent auth now 31/2/0/1. CIBA approval works only for an agent that belongs to the requesting host; proof of presence reuses plugin/passkey through an interface (new plugin/passkey/presence.go), so agentauth has no passkey dependency. Go minimums: core and plain plugins stay go 1.24; several modules (sso, oauthprovider, agentauth, oauthdevice, passkey, contrib adapters) declare go 1.25 - check whether agentauth/oauthprovider/sso truly need 1.25 before release.
